simulations.actor: farm operations manager at a medium or large grain producer
simulations.normal: plan harvest sequence and machinery capacity from crop maturity, weather, field access and storage availability
simulations.exception: weather forecast changes, uneven maturity, equipment failure or inaccessible field require replanning
simulations.degraded: compressed harvest window with limited machines, operators, trucks and receiving capacity
simulations.candidate: probabilistic harvest-readiness forecast feeding a constrained scheduling solver
simulations.baseline: agronomic inspection, weather forecasts, maturity rules, priority heuristics and constraint-based scheduling

simulations.normal: align expected arrivals with drying, aeration, silo and loading capacity
simulations.exception: quality variation, excess moisture, delayed trucks or unavailable silo changes feasible routing
simulations.degraded: regional harvest peak creates queues and drying bottlenecks
simulations.candidate: arrival and moisture forecast combined with deterministic capacity optimization
simulations.baseline: booking windows, queue rules, storage constraints, moisture thresholds and operations planning

simulations.actor: agronomic planning lead at a cooperative or multi-farm operation
simulations.normal: estimate seed, fertilizer, crop-protection and labor demand by field and operation window
simulations.exception: planting delay, replanting, pest pressure or supplier disruption changes demand
simulations.degraded: short planting window and constrained inventory require allocation across farms
simulations.candidate: probabilistic demand forecast feeding constrained allocation
simulations.baseline: crop plans, bills of materials, safety stocks, agronomic rules and mathematical optimization

training_data.observation_unit: one field-operation, harvest, receiving or input-planning interval with information available at planning time and later realized demand or capacity outcome
training_data.input_data: crop stage, field, weather forecast, historical operations, equipment, labor, inventory, transport, storage and agronomic constraints available before planning
training_data.target_or_reward: realized harvest readiness, arrivals, workload or input demand; solver objective combines delay, loss, cost and constraint violations
training_data.label_source: operational records, agronomic observations, receiving logs and inventory movements; completeness is unknown
training_data.prediction_time: before daily or weekly harvest, receiving, procurement or allocation planning
training_data.expected_volume: unknown; must be measured by farm, field, crop and planning horizon
training_data.class_balance: not applicable as a fixed classification balance; demand regimes and disruption frequency are unknown
training_data.historical_coverage: unknown and likely fragmented across farm-management, weather, machinery, storage and cooperative systems
training_data.train_validation_split: time-based split with season, farm or region holdout where sufficient coverage exists
training_data.leakage_risks: using realized weather, final yield, actual arrivals, completed operations, revised plans or inventory corrections unavailable at planning time
training_data.representativeness_risks: crop, cultivar, soil, region, season, weather regime, management practice, machinery and farm scale
training_data.feedback_loop: recommended schedules and allocations change later observations; overrides, reasons and realized outcomes must be logged
training_data.privacy_and_usage_constraints: protect farm commercial data, land and production information and avoid worker-performance inference
training_data.fallback_if_data_is_insufficient: use official forecasts, agronomic rules, scenario ranges, safety stocks and deterministic constraint optimization

material_differentiation: No separate opportunity remained after comparison. Harvest, receiving and input planning are valid forecasting and optimization problems, but their intelligent mechanisms and outcomes substantially repeat existing demand, capacity, storage and operational-planning patterns. The agriculture-specific constraints are configuration and data-integration adaptations rather than a materially distinct opportunity.

where_ai_enters.optional_secondary_mechanism: deterministic constrained scheduling or allocation solver
